screen: Execute Accrual/Deferral of Expenses and Revenues

valuationClass.label: Valuation Class
valuationClass.note: A coded value - 0005 = Short Term under Valuation Area 001. Read from the field's own F4 help, never typed as prose. NOT the same field as the deal screen's 'Gen. Valn Class' dropdown.

transaction.label: Transaction (OTC Transactions block)
transaction.note: The deal number. Scopes the run to one deal.

keyDate.label: Accrual/Deferral Key Date
keyDate.note: Month-end of the term's start month, not the start date itself.

results.note: TPM44 lands directly on an inline ALV list on wnd[0] - no popup, unlike TBB1. Read it with screen labels; rows carry update types (AD1000/AD1001), prorated amounts and the key date.
